description: Fetch one registry dataset as a single export: dataset components (the live registry’s components, objects and traits), tokens or manifest. The reply carries the export’s version date, an etag, sizeBytes and the payload. listVersions returns the dated exports instead of a payload, and version picks one of them (the nearest earlier date, with a warning, when that date has none). Pass a previous etag as ifNoneMatch to get matched: true and no payload when nothing changed; includePayload: false omits the payload anyway. includeInternal applies to components only. Use catalog_list instead to filter components a page at a time. Read-only; the Stage1 run kinds need local stdio.

inputSchema.description: Read a pinned registry dataset or list its available versions.

ifNoneMatch.description: Return matched=true without payload when the ETag matches.

includeInternal.description: Live components dataset only: also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them; a dated export is served unchanged.

includePayload.description: When false, omit payload even if no ETag match occurs.

listVersions.description: When true, return available version dates instead of payload.

version.description: Request a specific date-stamped version (e.g., '2026-02-24'). Omit for latest. Applies to dataset mode only.
